name: Anantara Convento di Amalfi Grand Hotel
insider_take: This 13th-century Capuchin monastery has been transformed into one of the world's most romantic clifftop retreats, where centuries of sacred history meet modern luxury on the dramatic Amalfi coastline.
whats_special: The hotel's ancient cloisters and frescoed chapel create an otherworldly atmosphere, while the infinity pool appears to spill directly into the Mediterranean. The original monastery's bell tower offers panoramic views of Amalfi's pastel-colored houses cascading down to the sea, and guests can explore the underground tunnels once used by monks.
pro_tip: Book the Belvedere Suite in the original tower for exclusive access to a private terrace built into the clifftop, offering unobstructed sunrise views over the Gulf of Salerno.
dont_miss: The hotel's private beach club accessible via a scenic coastal path, and evening aperitivos in the ancient cloister garden where centuries-old olive trees are illuminated against stone archways. The nearby Emerald Grotto sea cave is just a 10-minute boat ride away.
pros: Historic 13th-century monastery converted into luxury hotel with original architectural features
Spectacular clifftop location with panoramic Mediterranean Sea views
Award-winning spa and wellness facilities in ancient monastery setting
Prime location in Amalfi town center with easy access to coastal attractions
cons: Historic building layout may present accessibility challenges
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
